name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Keep the V0.74 fast first calendar frame with Saturday blue, Sunday red and today green before holiday processing. Make the 35-day holiday phase cooperative: compute one date per event-loop turn, accumulate all results in RAM, do not change holiday colors until all 35 checks are complete, then repaint all holiday cells together and flip once. Harden tap recognition so only a measured <=400 ms second tap is a double tap, clear stale tap timestamps on every reset, and prevent delayed timers from turning an expired single tap into a false double.
